547. Marriages fixed by sakunam ( Omen ) The parents get vexed when they go on collecting horoscopes and getting them examined by a few astrologers. They complain •that the astrologers have agreed to disagree with each other just like clocks in the same compound. They are already worried in finding out a suitable boy for the girl. Secondly, there are so many other considerations in the selection of the boy. In there anxiety, ■they are confused. When they approach the astrologer in a confused state, they are still more eonfused, so that, in course of time, they •decide, not to consult any astrologer, and they pin their faith in God, look at the Sakunam or Nimitham, and fix up the marriage which is really good.

548. Such people and even those who have faith not only in , astrology, but slso in the astrologer whom they consult, can follow . Sakuman. It is the real Divine guidance. It will never fail. Saku— ,nam is more important than the Dasaporutham. This is our honest .and sincere opinion. He who has to take a decision after noting the Sakunam, should pray to God or Goddess in whom he or she has faith Then what one hears or sees at that time will offer the correct prediction. One should not artificially create a Sakunam, e.g., at the time you start, you should not instruct your child to turn the key of the alarm time piece and allow it to ring ; nor ask any Sumangali, a young girl, leading a good life with her husband to come in front of you.

549. But you allow the Sakunam to nature. If the cat were to come before you, once for all forget the matter and give up the attempt. If a cow comes, proceed. If anybody brings the idol of God, proceed. Even if you are sure that you will come by fortune, if you make an attempt in any direction and if at that time a widow were to come, be sure that you will be disappointed and misfortune will surely be the result. If you hear the sound of a bell, etc., you may proceed.

550. If the ■light is put off by strong wind or if the electric light fails ■due to * fuse of the wire ’ or failure of the current, it foreshadows ■evil results, and that the alliance in consideration will fall through. 'Similarly, there are hundreds of omens Sakunams. Varahamihira says that an omen reveals the fruition of his deeds, ■according to the good deeds and bad ones done in the previous birth. Omens are not superstitious beliefs. Actually they are very correct indications. Sa-gunam means good quality. That is why this method of finding out the truth is called Sakunam.

551. There are many other omens which are rural, wild, aquatic terrestrial, heavenly, diurnal, nocturnal, and diurnal-nocturnal Nimitham needs intelligence to interpret. But if it is properlyinterpreted, this is superior to Sakunam and will be more appropriate and explanatory. It will not be out of place if a few instances are given. Once a Guru was teaching the students as how to interpret incidents and understand the future. At that time, the Guru’s wife went out of the house to fetch water from a common well provided with a pulley alone.

552. She had to take the rope and the bucket, She did carry them along with her. In the meanwhile, a gentleman approached the teacher and requested him to offer a prediction. The Guru asked him “ What is your difficulty ? What is it that you want ? ” The person said: * My wife and I did not pull on amicably. She went to her native place a year ago, and in spite of my repeated reminders and registered letters, she never cared to reply. I am really worried.

553. I would like to know whether she will divorce me, desert me and leave in the lurch, or at least, after some time, she will come to her senses and join me ’. As he was saying this, the Guru’s wife returned empty handed and waited for the visitor to finish his narration. The moment he completed his story, she said to her husband that the rope, she used gave way, while dragging the water and hence, the pot has fallen into the well. Now, the Guru asked the students to interpret his wife’s report to the query of the visitor.

554. All the students except one told the Guru: ‘ Sir, we call marriage as a bondage’; we tie the saffron thread around the neck of the bride to. show, that she is married. We call it as Thali, or Mangalya saradu. As your wife complains that the rope has given way, we have to take that the mangalya saradu has become weak; it will be cut off shortly, and hence she will not join him. It will end in a divorce.’ Only one student remained silent and was hearing the explanation of all the others.

555. Even the visitor was upset, when he heard the lady saying ‘ the rope has given way.’ He called her within himself ‘ as Saturn : wherefrom this Saturn is come now, and so on’. The Guru asked the student ‘ What is your opinion ? What have you got to say ? Do you agree with them or do you differ from them ’ ? This intelligent student said “ Sir, it is a fact that Mangalyam is a thread and tying it around the neck of the bride is the custom to say that the bride is married to him.

556. Traditionally, it is done by us all. But now, we have to consider as follows. The rope used for pulling the water from the well is the evil force which tries to separate a part of the water from the large quantity of water in the well. This poftul of water belongs to the well. The rope tries to separate this water from its kin. But the evil period is over. The rope has given way. There is no more evil. Hence, shortly, she will come and join him, just like the water in the pot which belonged to the well again joined in that well and is safe.” The wise teacher agreed with the student, who gave the verdict that the wife would come and join, encouraged the visitor, and declared that divorce was out of question, and that his wife would surely come and join him.

557. Also he advised him to wait for some time, till the evil period was over, so that automatically she would come and join him. Actually after the lapse of some tin the wife joined her husband. Thus, the incident may be one and the same, but the interpretation may be bothways. Answer: “Kendra” is a Sanskrit word. It is also called ■Chatustaya and Kantaka. The sign in which the Ascendant (Lagna) falls, the fourth sign counted from the birth sign, the seventh sign from the ascendant (Lagna) and the 10th sign counted from the ascendant are termed Kendra signs or Kendra houses.

934. It may also be used with reference to the position of the sign occupied by Moon and other planets. On such occasions, it is said that a planet is in a Kendra to Moon or in a Kendra to any other planet. By that, it is meant that they are conjoined with it in the same sign, or in the 4th, 7th or 10th signs counted from the sign occupied by the Moon •or any other planet. (1) The exact longitude of the Ascendant in a sign or that of the Moon is not at all taken for calculation.

935. But only the sign in which the Ascendant falls is taken whether it is zero degree 1 minute cr 29 degrees 59 minutes in that sign.. So also when counted from Moon or any other planet, only the sign, which they occupied, will be taken for judgment and not the Bhava (the House). In most of the horoscopes, the first part of a sign may be included in a House (or Bhava) and the second part of the sign will be in the next house (or Bhava) : Whether the planet is in the first part or in the second part of the Sign and in whichever house it is, it is not at all taken to find Kendrasthana, but only the sign in which the planet is found.

Joumo/t A transit, in a literal sense, is the passage of a planet in the heavens by ephemeral motion as seen from the current year’s ephemeris or panchang. The planets continually travel through the Zodiac and every day they change their relation one to another.

1053. In Astrology, the term ‘transit’ is used in a wider sense. A planet, moving in the heavens at a given time, may arrive at a degree which may happen to be the place occupied by it in the birth chart or the place of another planet at birth or the degree constituting the cusp of a house in the horoscope.

1054. It would then be a conjunction by transit. Or, it may be located in such a degree in the Zodiac wherefrom it will be in a certain aspect to the degree where a planet was at birth or to the degree on the cusp of a house (bhava) in the birth chart. It would then be said to be transiting in sextile, square, trine, etc., to the radical planet or the radical cusp. When a planet passes over the position of a progressed planet or reaches a degree wherefrom it is in some aspect to the place of the progressed planet, it would be considered as being in conjunction or aspect to the progressed planet.

1055. This is what we are concerned with. For instance, Jupiter during its travel through the Zodiac by ephemeral motion may reach a certain degree in the Zodiac which may be the place occupied by the Sun at the birth time or a degree which is in a certain aspect to the degree where the Sun was at birth. Neither Jupiter nor the Sun are stationary; they ever move in the heavens.

1149. HORA AND ITS USE The ecliptic is the apparent pathway of the Sun in theHeavens. The planets and the other luminary Moon, follow their own individual tracks which lie along the ecliptic on north and south of it. The width on either side is about 7$* and hence the pathway of the planets is around 15° in width, having the ecliptic in its centre. This is called the Zodiac. If one observes, it will appear that the whole Zodiac goes round the earth once a day, i.e., once in 24 hours and the same portion of the Zodiac rises in the east in 23 hours 56 minutes and a few seconds.

1150. As the Zodiac is divided into 12 equal parts called Solar mansion (sign or rasi) (Mesha—Aries to Meena—Pisces), each division will be appearing in the east, roughly for a duration of 2 hrs. In other words, the previous sign will appear to rise up in the heavens and the next sign will commence to rise nearly two hours after the previous sign began to rise. Hence the 12 signs rise in the east, roughly at an interval of 2 hours. The Hindu astrologers have subdivided each sign into two halves and called such a division as a Hora.

Diabetes Diabetes mellitus is often simply referred to as diabetes, is a condition in which a person has a high blood sugar (glucose) level as a result of the body either not producing enough insulin, or because body cells do not properly respond to the insulin that is produced.

407. Insulin is a hormone produced in the pancreas, which enables body cells to absorb glucose, to turn into energy. If the body cells do not absorb the glucose, the glucose accumulates in the blood (hyperglycemia), leading to various potential medical complications. The pancreas is a gland organ in the digestive and endocrine system of vertebrates. It is both an endocrine gland producing several important hormones, including insulin, glucagon, and somatostatin, as well as an exocrine gland, secreting pancreatic juice containing digestive enzymes that pass to the small intestine. These enzymes help in the further breakdown of the carbohydrates, protein, and fat in the chyme.

412. These three malignant properties of cancers differentiate them from benign tumors, which are self-limited, and do not invade or metastasize. Cancer affects people at all ages with the risk for most types increasing with age. Caixer caused about 13% of all human deaths in 2007 (7.6 million). Cancers are caused by abnormalities in the genetic material of the transformed cells. 10. My explanation is: So far as I am aware there is no book dealing exclusively with this subject and in the manner I have done. Mention may be made in this connection of Astrology and Marriage by Sepharial—a book containing fifty-nine pages, which enunciates some basic principles of Astrology in relation to married happiness. But to my mind that book, though very interesting, touches only the outline of the subject and a desire is created in the mind of the reader, to know more, and delve deeper into the study of this fascinating subject.

11. This is no doubt a tribute to the eminent author, because, as I have stated, it has been successful in creating an interest in the subject. Then, there is another book Successful Marriage by Pharos. This is, comparatively speaking, a voluminous book closely printed and covering about 218 pages. But this deals only with the influence of 'Sun', according as the Sun is in one Zodiacal sign or the other, at the time of birth. Even the subject of matching the horoscopes— astrological judgment depending upon planetary configurations—how far a particular male would have successful marriage with a particular female—has been limited to the influence of the 'sign' in which the 'Sun' is.

12. So that, this book—though no doubt of immense interest to the layman—is of little use to the astrologer who, while acknowledging the superior influence of the mighty Sun, considers its influence on the married life and happiness as just one of the many factors and not the factor. Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage Then, there are a number of eminent authors, dealing fully with the entire subject of astrology, casting a horoscope and delineation of it, who have—most of them—based their structures on the ptolemic foundation. These eminent authors have dealt with all aspects of life—health, wealth, brethren, home, parents, children, married happiness, business, position and activity, friends, journeys to foreign land, incarceration, imprisonment and a list of other subjects which touch some department or other of human life.

13. Had I attempted such a thing, the present volume would have become too bulky and would have entirely defeated the very purpose which has been kept in view. The purpose is twofold: (a) To keep exclusively within the limits of the subjectmatter which comes under 'Love and Marriage' and thus confine the study to human emotions and affairs dealing with this department of life alone. Thus, if a planet, say in the seventh House, denotes influence on marriage, business partnerships, etc. or again if a planet in a particular sign gives certain sex-propensities as well as disease, the discussion here has been confined to marriage and sex propensities alone, because the other matter should be considered under business or health.

14. Many readers would no doubt consider that procreation of children is a corollary of marriage and as such some interested readers had appreciated this book better, if that matter also had been allotted its rightful place in this book. But with that line of argument, many more subjects would have claimed simultaneous attention and my effort to confine the study to one subject alone would have been defeated. That would have made the volume bulky and at the same time taken away that simplicity of arrangement— which is the special feature of this book.

15. (b) To explain what I mean by 'simplicity of arrangement' I must refer the readers to the contents of the book. Look to the contents of Part I. You have the influence of the Preface to the First Edition (1) Sun in twelve signs; (2) Sun in twelve houses; (3) Moon in twelve signs; (4) Moon in twelve houses; (5) Mars in twelve signs; (6) Mars in twelve houses and so on. Now, if an astrologer or even a layman who knows something about signs and houses and aspects wants to ascertain the specific influence, he can commence looking up with Sun's influence in a particular sign and then Sun's influence in a particular house.

16. There are twelve signs and twelve houses. One need confine his attention to Sun's influence in the particular sign in the horoscope under enquiry. Then one may safely skip the pages dealing with Sun's influence in other signs. Similarly, one may look up the required effect of the Sun's house position in the particular house the Sun is situated and leave the other pages. One may next proceed with the Moon in a similar manner and then with Mars and Mercury and so on. This arrangement has been made to facilitate summing up influences.

17. It is true that in a horoscope the influences are not isolated, but synthetic i.e., a particular effect is not the result of one planet alone—much less the effect of a planet's 'sign' position only or 'house' position only. But how to know the cumulative effect, unless one knows the individual effect ? The art of synthesis is the most delicate art—of blending similar and dissimilar influences and arriving at the resultant influence. It requires prudence and knowledge and experience but above all, one must know what one is synthesising.

18. Unless one knows the component forces how can one know the resultant force ? It happens many a time that when a particular horoscope is being examined some points are missed. In the present volume all component or individual effects have been carefully classified, grouped and arranged, so that one has not to hunt in all directions— to find the effect of any particular influence, either due to sign or house or aspect or any other factor. Thus, this book affords the same facility as a classified catalogue, so that one knows where one would find what one is looking for and can directly put his finger in the right place.

19. Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage It is this arrangement, which I may be permitted to state is the 'key-note' or the very special feature, which no doubt would save a lot of time and energy, which one has usually to expend in looking through the various standard texts. Another consideration, which has prompted me to bring out this book is to make available to the readers the principles and practice of Western as well as Hindu Astrology in one single volume. There are many books in English dealing with Principles of Western Astrology.

It has been my good fortune to study and admire the salient features of both the systems. On one hand, I attach importance to the tropical Zodiac, which regulates Sunrise and Sunset, durations of day and night, climate, seasons, crops and so many geographical and other influences having a bearing on the flora and the fauna and it would be but natural to presume that it exerts influence in similar manner in regard to human beings also, and the 'Kalapurush' must have a constant analogy to the moveable Zodiac, on the other, believing as I do in stellar influence, I have deep and abiding faith in the influence of the ambient—containing billions and billions of stars.

21. The Sanskrit texts are all one in regard to the influence of the fixed stars and 'nakshatra Vidya' or the 'knowledge of the fixed stars', is the foundation of Hindu astrology. Not only the Vedic texts but the greatest and the first epic of the Hindus, the Valmiki Ramayana, written many centuries before Christ refer to the natal star 'nakshatra' of Dasharath having been afflicted by Sun, Mars and Rahu (northern node of the Moon). This same epic, written many centuries before Christ also mentions the phenomenon of earth's movement round the Sun.

22. In modem times, even eminent Western astrologers like Mr. Cyril Fagan, Mr. E.V. Robson, Mr. W.J. Tucker, Mr. DA. Bradley and others have recognised the importance of the Sidereal Zodiac. In the Hindu system not only the division of the Zodiac, but the Dasha System (Directions) is based upon fixed constellations. So, to my mind, any system which does Preface to the First Edition not take cognisance of the 'immoveable' or fixed Zodiac would be incomplete. So, the first difference between the two systems is of the moveable or fixed Zodiac.

23. The second difference between the two systems is that of application by aspects. The third major difference is of Directions. Besides, there are other differences in the two systems, which are already well-known to the students of astrology. And to others, those who are beginners, the matter would gradually unfold itself, as they go through these pages. I have purposely not mixed one system with the other. That would have only confused the issue. Besides, it would not have been fair to of the systems to break it, in order to fit in with the other.

The horoscope of a man is nothing more than the plotting of the different planets in their respective positions at the time of the native's birth.

119. In Hindu Astrology: (i) The aspect between two benefics is always good. (ii) The aspect of a malefic is always bad. (iv) Sun, Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Moon (having less than 8 digits) and Mercury conjoined with a malefic are deemed malefics. Mars acts as a greater malefic than Sun. Rahu and Ketu are more malefic than Mars; Saturn is the greatest malefic. (v) The lord of the first house, whichever planet it may be, is not considered a malefic.

172. CHAPTER 2 THE THREE CENTRES The Rising Sign, the Moon and the Sun are the three Centres in a horoscope from which judgement of any house is done. Together they rule the body, the mind and the Soul respectively of a person. If any one of the three centre is weak then it affects the entire horoscope in a negative manner. On the other hand, if all the three are strong then the remaining planets will not be able to show much adverse effects. Let us come to the present book which deals with the Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage.

660. If the lord of the 1st and 6th houses be conjoined with malefics, same as above; the native is too lustful. 26. If the lord of the 1st house is conjoined with or aspected by benefics owning die 7th house or posited in the 7th house, rise of fortune after marriage. 27. If the lord of the 1st house is in benefic 'anshas' and the lord of the 2nd and 7th houses are strong in 'para-vatansha' early marriage. Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage 28. If the lord of the 1st, 2nd and 6th houses along with malefics be in the 7th house, the native is adulterous. 29.

661. Lord of the 1st house in seventh well-aspected; the native's wife is good-looking and well-behaved. 30. If the lord of the 1st house along with a benefic be in the 7th house: the native marries from a good family. 31. If the lord of the 1st house is in the 7th house in a 'papa' rashi: the native's wife is from a low family. 32. If the lord of the 1st house is conjoined with the lord of the 7th house, the native's wife will be beautiful but if it be combust then the wife would not be good-looking. 33.

662. If the lord of the 1st and/or 7th house, be in debilitation, combust or in the 'navamsha' of enemy and in malefic 'shashtiansha' (l/60th division) the native may have to marry a third time. 34. If the lord of the 1st house is in the 7th house conjoined with the lord of the 7th and if the 7th house or its lord be strong, good will result, otherwise, if they are weak it will not be conducive to good results. 35. If the lord of the 1st is devoid of strength and weaker than the lord of the 7th house, and associated with a malefic or in a malefic house or in a debilitated 'ansha' or descending (going down towards its debilitation sign) the native himself/ herself is of inferior status than the marriage partner. 36.

663. If the lord of the 1st house is stronger than the lord of the 7th house and ascending (i.e. going towards the exaltation sign) or is in exalted 'varga' or 'ansha' or in a 'kendra' or in a 'trikona' with a benefic, the native himself is superior in status to his wife's family. 37. If the lords of the 1st and 7th houses are of equal strength the status of the two (husband and wife) is equal, i.e. both come from families of the same standard. 38. See whether the lords of the 1st and the 7th house in a horoscope are friends or enemies.

664. It is good for conjugal happiness if they are friends. Vice versa. 39. If the lord of the 1st and 7th houses are great enemies and in quincunx the husband and wife would be inimical (see for other indications as well). Lords of Houses 40. If the lord of the 1st and 7th houses are great friends and apply to each other both (husband and wife) would be friendly. (Look to other indications also.) 41. If the lord of the ascendant has a good number of benefic points in its 'ashtakvarga' in the 7th house and if the lord of the 7th house is associated with the lord of the 1st house and is strong, good will result. 42.

665. If the lord of the ascendant has a small number of benefic points in its 'ashtakvarga' in the 7th house and is associated with the lord of the 7th house who in its turn is weak, bad results would follow. 43. If the 7th house or the lord thereof has 'bandh'* with the lord of the first house, it is favourable for matrimonial happiness. 44. If the lord of the 1st house be in the the 8th house and a malefic in the 7th house and lord of the 2nd house also conjoined with a malefic, there would be more than one marriage.

666. Note. The sign and 'navamsha' occupied by the (i) lord of the ascendant, (ii) lord of the sign occupied by Moon, and (iii) lord of the 7th house. The husband/wife will have some attributes pertaining to the lords of these or their exaltation or depression signs. 46. Add together the longitudes of the following: (a) the lord of the 1st house and Venus, and (b) the planets in whose signs the lords of the 1st and 7th house are posited. The Janma-rashi (radical Moon's) of the wife would be one of the two above or in trine to them. 47.

667. If the lord of the 1st house is in the 12th house aspected by an enemy, pleasures of life are denied to the native. Two planets are said to be in 'bandha' when they fully aspect each other or mutually exchange sings or both are in angles or trine, i.e. in 1,4,7,10 or in 5 and 9 as counted from ascendant. Astrological Secrets of Friendship. Love and Marriage 48. Add the longitudes of (1) lord of ascendant and Venus. The longitude indicated by the sum total is a sensitive point in regard to conjugal happiness, i.e. if it is conjoined with benefics it is good.

668. Vice versa. 49. Add the longitudes of (i) lord of ascendant and (ii) lord of the 7th house. The longitude indicated by sum total, if wellplaced, well conjoined and well aspected; good for matrimonial happiness. Vice versa. 2nd House Second house and its lord is an important factor as family (wife, children etc.) are judged from it. It is also important because whereas the seventh house indicate the spouse, the second house (being the 8 th house as counted from the 7 th house) indicate the termination of the life or relationship with the wife.

669. Due to this fact in some parts of Southern India, the placement of Mars in the second house is also taken in 'Kuja* Dosha' or 'Manglik' effects. We now give below the effects of the second house and its lord: 1. If only one strong benefic planet conjoins the lord of the 2nd house; only one wife. 2. Lord of the 2nd house conjoined with a 'Papa': the native is attached to another's wife. 3. If the lord of the 2nd house is in the house of Mars or associated with or aspected by Venus, the native resorts to cunnilinctus. 4.

670. If the lord of the 2nd house be in the 7th house or associated with a number of planets, the native will have more than one wife. 5. (i) If the lord of the 2nd house be in the 7th house and (ii) if the lord of the 7th house in the 7th house: the person would have only one wife. Kuja Dosha means break up of the first marriage unless due to other factors it is nullified. Lords of Houses 6. If the lord of the 2nd be in the 10th house, the native would be adulterous. 7.

671. If the lord of the 2nd house is conjoined with a weak planet (s) owning 'trik'; as many wives demise as is the number of planets that conjoin. 8. If the lord of the 2nd house is in the 7th house the wife is fond of luxuries, intent upon saving money, but if the planet be a malefic, she may be barren. 9. Lord of 2nd in the 4th/10th house; native is inclined to have amours with other people's wives. 10. If the lord of the 2nd house is weak, combust, debilitated, in a great enemy's house, in 'paparashi', 'ansha' or aspected by malefics, the wife would be from a lower family. 11.

672. If the lord of the 'navamsha' in which the lord of the 2nd house is posited is with a benefic, and in its own or exaltation Vargas' in 'paravatansha', the native has a number of wives or enjoys a number of ladies. 12. If there are malefics in the 2nd and 7th houses in a male nativity, they bring about sorrow by the death of the partner. If such combinations are found in the nativity of the wife also, it nullifies the effect. 13. If there are malefics in the 2nd house, the 9th and 10th house, the wife comes from a distant place. 14.

673. If malefics in their depression or inimical houses are posited in the 7th house, the 8th and 2nd houses, it is bad for the longevity of both, husband and wife. 15. The lords of the 2nd house, the 6th and 12th houses from ascendant are not good for 7th house. (Because they become lords of the 6th house, the 8th and 12th houses, if counted from the 7th house). 16. If the lords of the 2nd, and 7th houses are strong, there would be conjugal happiness. 17. If the lords of the 2nd house, the 7th and 10th houses are in the 10th house: same as above. 18.

674. If the lord of the 2nd house or the 7th or 10th houses be in 4th house it indicates liaison with other person's wife. Astrological Secrets of Friendship. Love and Marriage 19. If the lord of the 2nd and 7th houses are in 'Gopuransha', and the lord of the 10th house is in the 7th house, the native is very lucky in love and marriage and has a number of wives. 20. If (a) planets owning the 2nd house, the 7th and 12th houses be posited in 'kendra' and trikona' and are aspected by Jupiter (b) benefics be posited in the 2nd house, the 7th house, the 11th house from the lord of the 7th house; conjugal happiness is indicated. 21.

675. If the lord of the 2nd and 12th houses are in the 3rd and aspected by Jupiter or by the lord of the 9th house, a man has several wives. Note. When Hindu astrological works were written, polygamy was common in India. Now, we should interpret the rules against the present social and legal background. 3rd to 6th Houses We cannot separate a part from the whole so the importance of 3 rd , 4 th , 5 th , and 6 th houses in a horoscope is also considered in estimating success in a love relationship.

676. The 3 rd house indicates the mind, the manner of thinking and communication and a person's success depends upon his ability of comprehension and expression. The 4th house is important as it indicates the atmosphere at home and happiness. Conjugal happiness is a very important part of life. The 5 th house controls love life of an individual. The 6 th house being the 12 th from the 7 th house (marriage) indicates the destruction (or loss) of marriage. Benefic planets in the 3 rd , 4 th , 5 th and 6 th houses indicates a harmonious mind, a happy life, success in love as well as good family life.

677. We now give the effect of the third house to sixth house: 3rd House 1. The third' house being in trine to the 7th house, affects conjugal happiness according as there are benefics or malefics in the house. 2. Lord of the 3rd house in the 7th house: the native's wife Lords of Houses is of good temper and prosperous but if the planet be a malefic, the native's wife may have a liaison with a family member younger than the native. (Look for other confirmatory configurations also). 4th House 3.

678. Malefics in 4th house impair happiness in general while the benefics enhance the same. Planets herein therefore play an important role. 4. If the lord of the 4th house in the 7th house be a malefic, the native's wife disobeys the native's father. If it be Mars or Venus the native's wife comes from a good family. 5. If the lord of the 4th house is in the 7th house and friendly with lord of the 7th house and conjoined with or aspected by it gain of land/property through husband/wife is indicated.

679. This would be so if the fourth house be also strong. 5th House 6. The 5th house is the house of children, and as such interconnected with the 7th house. Benefics herein are good for the 7th house happiness. Vice versa. 7. If the 5th house is tenanted by the lord of the 6th house, the 7th house, 8th or 12th houses it is not good. 8. If the lords of the 5th and 7th houses are strong and aspected by malefics and conjoined with or aspected by the lord of the the 6th house then the native's wife would have a paramour (look for other indications also). 9.

680. Lords of the 5th or 8th houses in 7th are not good for wife's longevity. 10. If the lord of the 5th house is in the 7th house (ii) the lord of the 11th house conjoined with a malefic (iii) and Venus, be weak the wife runs serious risk to health during pregnancy or delivery. 11. If the lord of the 5th and 7th houses are strong and aspected by benefics: good for conjugal happiness, 12. If the lord of the 5th house is in the 7th house the native's wife is loving, well-behaved and of even temper but if the Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage lord of the 5th house is in 8th, he does not enjoy conjugal happiness for long. 6th House 13.

681. The sixth house is twelfth from the 7th house and as such planets herein affect adversely the 7th house. 14. If 6th and 8th houses from the ascendant are occupied by malefics it is unfavourable for wife's longevity/married happiness. 15. If lord of the 6th house is in the 7th house the native's wife is always opposing the husband, is very ill-tempered and always causes mental anguish to the husband. If the planet be a benefic, she may be barren or there may be abortions. 16. If the lord of the 6th house be a malefic and in 9th, the native is full of lust. 17.

682. If the fifth and 7th houses from L/L.A.* are aspected by or conjoined with benefics it is good for married happiness. 18. If the houses referred to above are conjoined with or aspected by malefics it is bad. 7th House This entire book in fact is devoted to the 7 th house. A relationship between the native and his spouse. In the following chapter special effects (as mentioned in the Hindu System) of the Seventh House is given below: 1. The physical attributes of the wife would be according to the planet in the 7th house. 2.

683. If there is a benefic sign in the 7th house and the same is aspected by Jupiter, the native is not adulterous. 3. Even signs on the cusp of 7th house are good for conjugal happiness. Lord of the 7th house in even sign: good for conjugal happiness. 4. If the 7th house or 'navamsha' therein is owned by a benefic, the native gets a virtuous wife. If the same is aspected by benefics good for conjugal happiness. 5. If the cusp of the 7th house is in malefic 'ansha' or * 'L' is abbreviated form of Lagna or (Ascendant) L/A means Lunar Ascendant, i.e the sign in which Moon is posited Lords of Houses aspected by a malefic, the marriage would be in a distant place, 6.

684. If the 7th house is in the 'varga' of Saturn or Mars and if Venus is aspected by Saturn or Mars, the native is addicted to other women. 7. If the 7th house itself or the lord of the house is hemmed in between malefics, the native may marry again, 8. If there are several malefics in 7th and the lord of the 7th is conjoined with malefics and if Ketu is in the 6th the native's two wives—one after the other die and he marries a third time, 9.

685. Planets in the 7th house from lagna or Moon, if benefics, confer happiness. Vice versa, 10. If three or more planets be strong in the 7th house, the native will have several wives or love affairs. 11. If lord of the 'trika' is in the 7th house it spoils the house (conjugal happiness). 12. If the 7th house has malefics it is a bad augury for matrimonial happiness. If there are malefics in the 7th house and they are aspected also by malefics, there may be disease in private parts, 13.

686. If there is 'Dhuma' in the 7th there is no marriage or delayed marriage. If there is 'Karmuk' there may be premature death of the partner, if there is 'Parivesh' the wife would be ill-tempered and ill-behaved and if 'ketu' therein, she may be barren. If there is 'Kala' there may be no marriage or wife may die prematurely. If there is a 'papa' in the 7th house the wife may have miscarriages. 14. When 'Mandi' is in 7th house, it acts like a mangal dosha (malefic influence similar to Mars).

687. The native is very passionate but wife/husband's longevity is impaired. 15. If the 7th house is conjoined with' Yamkantak' it is good. If the 7th house is conjoined with 'Gulika'—it is evil. Even the lord of 'Gulika' in the 7th house is bad. 16. If there is a planet in the 7th house in the sign of Venus the number of wives is the same as the number of the planet(s) which conjoin or aspect such planet. 17. If the 7th house is conjoined with or aspected by its Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marric lord, Jupiter, Mercury or Venus it is good; if aspected by malefics, it is unfavourable. 18.

688. If the 7th house is aspected by a malefic, wife of the native is sinful and evil-tempered. If the cusp of the 7th house is in malefic vargas the wife of the native would be inimical to the husband. 19. If the 7th house is weak and is tenanted by the lord of the 'trika' it is bad. If aspected by benefics the position is a little improved. 20. Even a benefic in an enemy's house in the 7th house is not good. 21. Also see whether the planet posited in the 7th house, is lord of a good house or a bad one. 22.

689. Even a malefic, if strong in its own house in the 7th house, would assure conjugal happiness. 23. A malefic planet in the 7th house and owning it, if weak spoils conjugal happiness. 24. If hermaphrodite planet (Mercury of Saturn) occupies the seventh house and the 11th house is occupied by two planets, there may be more than one marriage. 25. Benefic in the 7th house are good, unless they own a trika' place. 26. Greater the number of planets in the 7th house or aspecting it greater the number of women with whom one will associate. 27.

690. In 26 above if malefics aspect the 7th house, wife may die or happiness will not be ensured from such association. 28. If 'Gulika' is in the 7th house, the native will have more than one union and would be quarrelsome. 29. If a malefic occupies the 7th house and is aspected by another malefic, it is bad for longevity of wife/husband. 30. A malefic planet in the 7th house in the 'vargas' of a malefic gives a bad wife or destroys her. Note. If the above are aspected by benefics the evil is mitigated. 31.

691. If seventh house is tenanted by the lord of the 5th and Lords of Houses 8th, i.e. Jupiter in case of Sinha Lagna (Leo Ascendant) people and Mercury in case of Kumbha Lagna (Aquarius Ascendant) people; loss of husband/wife. 32. If the seventh house lord is conjoined with the lord of Mandi' Rashi, it spoils conjugal happiness. 33. If the seventh house is hemmed in between malefics, it indicates premature death of wife/husband. 34. If there be a benefic in seventh house and the house be hemmed in between benefics and these benefics be not conjoined or associated with malefics, it is extremely good for conjugal happiness and prosperity. 35.

692. Husband or wife should also be judged from the following: (a) by the planet posited in the 7th house. (b) by a planet aspecting the 7th house. 36. If planets of inharmonious elements are together in 7th house, they would create disease or mental unhappiness. 37. If the total number of benefic points in the 7th house exceeds 28 (out of 337) in 'Sarvashtak varga' it augurs well for conjugal happiness. Vice versa. 38. If the lord of the seventh house is in: (a) first house, the native is attached to his own wife and does not fall in love with other ladies, but if it be in the first house with a malefic, the native would be adulterous particularly, if Aries or Scorpio be the ascendant.

693. (b) second the native's wife is wicked and though the native may have monetary gain through/by marriage, the wife may not be well-behaved. (c) third in Taurus or Libra, then the number of wives would be according to the planets, which conjoin Venus. 39. If the lord of the seventh house is a malefic and in third the native's wife may have some liaison with some junior member in the family (look for other confirmatory indications also). 40. If the lord of the 7th house is in fourth the (i) native's wife may live separately for long periods, (ii) the native may Astrological Secrets of Friendship.

694. Love and Marriage have a liaison with another person's wife. This is so if the lord of the seventh and seventh house itself are weak and aspected by 'papas'. 41. If the 7th house lord is in the 4th house and the two lords are friendly and conjoined or aspecting each other, acquisition of land or building through wife may be predicted. 42. If the lord of the seventh is in the fifth (i) the native's wife may live for long, under the protection of his sons, (ii) the wife is sickly or the native has enmity with her.

695. If the planet be a malefic the native suffers from wasting disease due to over-indulgence. 43. If the lord of the 7th house is in the 7th house it is conducive to conjugal happiness. 44. If the lord of the 7th house is (i) in 8th the native spends much money on other women and may not have conjugal happiness. (ii) If the lord of 7th is in ninth, the native's wife is goodlooking but if the planet be a malefic the native would be full of lust and his virility would be impaired.

696. (iii) If in 10th, the native marries in a family higher than his own and is under the influence of his wife. The native would have some love affairs also. (iv) If in 11th the native's wife is good and well-behaved. 45. If lord of the 7th house is in the 11th house and lord of the 11th house in the 7th house, there may be gain through partnership. 46. If lord of the seventh house is in the 12th house the native may in his advanced age marry or have love affair with a woman of young age who may not be well-behaved. 47.

697. If the lord of the 7th is in 12th and the 12th lord is in 7th, partnership would result in much expenditure and financial difficulties. 48. If the lord of the 7th house from lagna or from 'Janmapati' dispositor of Moon is in 12th and if the lord of the lagna and Janmapati be malefics and occupy 7th, conjugal happiness is not warranted. 49. If the lord of the 7th house is in a 'papa' rashi and is Lords of Houses aspected by a 'papa' or is conjoined with one and is posited in an untoward house, i.e. 6th, 8th or 12th the native does not have matrimonial happiness adequately.

698. Vice versa. 50. If the lord of the 7th house is in the house of Mars or associated with or aspected by Venus the native resorts to cunnilinctus. 51. If the lord of the 7th house is posited in Taurus or Libra, the native is full of lust. 52. If the lord of the 7th house is exalted or retrograde in the 1st house, there would be more than one wife. 53. If the lord of the 7th house is exalted or in its own or friend's Vargas', in angle, trine or conjoined with the lord of the 10th, same as above, i.e. more than one wife/several love affairs. 54.

699. If the lord of the 7th is in 'Shubha ansha' and aspected by 'Shubha'* the native's wife comes from a good family. But if it is in a 'papa rashi' in 'papa vargas' or conjoined with a 'papa' then she comes from a bad family. 55. If the load of the sign, in which the 7th house lord is posited is weak or in 'trika' house conjugal happiness would be impaired. 56. If the lord of the 7th is in a 'Krura' 'Shashtiansha' the native has a bad wife. 57.

700. If the lord of the 'navamsha' in which lord of the 7th house is posited is in debilitation, combust or in enemy's sign or hemmed in between malefics or aspected by malefics the native may marry again. Judge similarly in relation to lord of the 7th house. 58. If the lord of the 7th house is in the ascendant, it is good particularly so if the lord of the ascendant also be in 7th house. 59. If the lord of the 7th house is in 'Kendra' in a shubha rashi, shubha ansha and aspected by shubha the native's wife would be virtuous. 60.

701. If the lord of the 7th house is in an angle or a trine exalted in its own house or in friend's house or in such vargas and aspected by the lord of the 10th, the native marries several times or has the enjoyment of several women. * 'Subha' means a benefic. Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage 61. If lord of the 7th and 11th houses are both in angles, same as above—several wives. 62. If the lord of the 7th house is in 'trika' it spoils the good effect of described above; the 8th house is the worst position.

702. Note. The evil is enhanced if it is in 'papa' vargas and aspected by malefics. The evil is mitigated if it is in 'shubha vargas' and aspected by benefics. 63. If the lord of the 7th house is in a sign near to that occupied by the lord of 1st house there would be early marriage. 64. If the lord of the seventh is in 'trik' and/or if the lord of the 'trik' is in 7th house it impairs matrimonial happiness but if the planet posited is benefic (though lord of trik it is not so had).

703. Also the evil is not fatal if there are benefic aspects on such planet. Look to other indications also. 65. If a malefic owns the 7th house and is posited in the 6th house, the 8th house, 12th or 2nd houses from lagna it destroys the 7th house prospects. 66. If a henefic owns the 7th house and is posited in the 6th house, the 8th house. 12th or 2nd house from lagna it is incapable of giving maximum good effect 67. If the lord of the 7th house occupy 'trika' position it will show bad results pertaining to the 7th house, if it be weak. 68.

704. In 62 above if it be strong, the injury would be only slight. 69. If the lord of the 7th is associated with or aspected by the lord of the trika the good effect is spoiled. 70. If the lord of the 7th is associated with a debilitated planet or is in a debilitated navamsha the native has a bad wife; not so if it has benefic aspect. 71. If the lord of the sign in which the 7th house lord is posited is associated with a number of planets more than one wife is indicated. 72.

705. If the lord of the 7th house is conjoined with a malefic and/or a malefic is posited in the 7th house or if the lord of the 'navamsha' in which the lord of the 7th house is posited is a malefic the native has a bad wife. 73. If the lord of the 7th house be conjoined with Saturn, Lords of Houses Mars, or Rahu and be in Krura 'shashtiansha' (l/60th div.) there may be more than one wife. 74. If the lord of the 7th house be in debilitation and associated with a benefic and if there be a malefic in the 7th house, there would be more than one marriage. 75.

706. If the lord of the 7th house along with a malefic be in the 1st house same as above. 76. In 74 and 75 above effects are modified if there are benefic aspects. 77. If the lord of the 7th house is conjoined with or aspected by a 'shubha' or is hemmed in between 'shubhas', the native has a good wife. 78. If the lord of the 7th house or the lord of the 2nd house is conjoined with weak planets who own the 6th house, the 8th or 12th houses as many wives demise as the number of the planets, which conjoin.

707. Similarly the number of wives is in accordance with 'shubha' planets that conjoin. If only one strong planet conjoins the lord of the 7th house, there is only one wife. 79. If the lord of the 7th house is with Rahu or Ketu the native is adulterous (look for confirmatory evidence). 80. If the lord of the 7th and 11th houses are together or fully aspected by each other, are strong and in the 5th or 9th house it is good for love and marriage. 81. If the lord of the 'navamsha', in which the lord of the 7th house is posited is with a benefic and is in own or exaltation Vargas', in Paravatansha, the native has a number of women. 82.

708. If the lord of the 7th house is posited in a 'shubhansha' and aspected by shubha planets or is in exalted 'ansha' or strong by being in several own or exalted Vargas', one marries in a high family. 83. If the lord of the 7th house is combust or in an enemy's 'ansha' or in association with another debilitated planet or is weaker than the lord of the 1st house, marriage would be in a lower family. 84. If the lord of the 7th house is in a debilitated ansha or otherwise debilitated the wife/husband would be from a lower family.

709. Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage 85. The sign, 'ansha' of the husband/wife is the same as occupied by the lord of the 7th house or the exaltation or debilitation sign of the lord of the 7th house. 86. If it is not one of the above, it is one in 'trine' to above. 87. If the lord of the 6th is associated with the lord of the 7th or 7th house or the 7th house lord is in 6th house, there may be enmity with women. 88. If the lord of the 7th house and 7th house itself are strong and/or connected with benefics Of have their aspects, the wife would be virtuous. 89.

710. If there be benefic sign in the 7th house unaspected by malefics it is good for conjugal happiness. 90. Mark the planets which exchange places with the lord of the 7th house, or are conjoined with it or are in full mutual aspect with it (they and the lord of the 7th house) or are in a square or trine to it. These planets would produce results connected with the 7th house and also connected with the house they are owners of. 91. If the lord of the 7th is conjoined with or placed in a ' Bandha' with the lords of the 6th house, the 8th or 12th houses from lagna, it is not good, 'Bandha' positions have been described above. 92.

711. Find out the number of points the lord of the 7th has in its own ashtakvarga. If the benefic points be 4 or more it would be good; if less then 4 it is not good. The Directions as they are technically called show the 'time' at which a particular event, warranted by the nativity, would occur.

834. In other words, if the horoscope answers the question 'what' the Directions answer the question 'when' ? The horoscope of birth never changes. It is the constant factor. If we compare a multistoreyed sky scraper to the life of a person, we may compare the birth horoscope or the radix to the ground floor. The progressed horoscope (position of planets and ascendant and M.C. for the 2nd year) is the second storey. The progressed horoscope for the 3rd year is the third storey. The progressed horoscope for the 60th year would be the 60th storey and so on.

835. I have imported the analogy of the multistoreyed building to show that just as dimensions of upper storey are conditioned by the dimensions or space occupied by the ground floor— in the same way the progressed horoscope for a particular year is conditioned by the dimensions or limitations of the radix (birthchart). The upper storey may be more beautiful or more airy or better furnished but you cannot conceive a 5,000 sqr. feet, hall on a subsequent storey—if the total area of the ground floor is only 500sq.feet. (a) Planets in the 2nd, 3rd, or 4th or in 10th, 11th or 12th house from each other are friends, (b) Planets in positions other than those mentioned in (a) above are enemies.

867. This is in regard to temporal friendship and enmity. Astrological Secrets of Friendship, Love and Marriage Five Kinds of Relationship 3. (a) Planets which are friends permanently as well as in temporal positions are great friends. (b) A planet which is a friend permanently but an enemy in temporal position is neutral. (c) If a planet is neutral permanently but a friend in regard to temporal position, is a friend. (d) If a planet is neutral permanently but enemy in regard to temporal position it is an enemy. (e) If a planet is an enemy permanently but friend in temporal position it becomes a neutral.

868. (f) If a planet is an enemy permanently and also an enemy by temporal position it becomes a great enemy. 4. The following are the friends of Rahu and Ketu. Friends: Mercury, Venus, Saturn. Enemies: Sun and Moon. Neutrals: Others. 5. (a) Rahu's exaltation sign is Gemini, debilitation sign is Sagittarius and Moola trikona is Aquarius. Its own house is Virgo. APPENDIX IV SUB-DIVISIONS (VARGAS) One unique system of finding the 'goodness' or 'badness' of a planet, usually employed in Hindu Astrology is to consider how a planet is placed in the various 'Vargas'. Varga' literally means one division or class or category. The following are the ten vargas: (i) Rashi: Full sign consisting of 30 degrees. (ii) Horn: A sign is divided into two halves first fifteen degrees (0-15) one division, the second 15 degrees (16-30) is the second division. The first half in odd signs, Aries Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, etc. is presided over by Sun, the latter half by Moon.

870. In even signs Taurus, Cancer, etc. the first half is presided over by Moon, the second by Sun. (iii) Dreshkana: A sign is divided into three divisions. First 10 degrees (0-10) are presided over by the lord of the sign itself, the middle ten degrees (11-20) by the lord of the fifth sign and last 10 degrees (21-30) by the lord of the ninth sign. Thus, in Aries the three lords are, lord of Aries (Mars) lord of Leo (Sun) lord of Sagittarius (Jupiter) and so on. (iv) Trinshansha-. (vii) Dwadashansha: A sign is divided in 12 divisions. 12 1/2°, 2 l/2°-5°, 5°-7 1/2° and so on. Each of the twelve divisions are allotted to signs as counted from the sign itself. Thus, the twelve sub-divisions in Aries are allotted to Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and so on. 12 subdivisions in Taurus are allotted to Taurus, Gemini, Cancer and soon.

876. (viii) Dashamansha: A planet is sub-divided into 10 divisions. (a) l°-3°. Astrological Secrets qf Friendship, Love and Marriage (b) 3°-6°. (c) 6°-9° and so on. Thus, in Aries to Aries, Taurus, etc. up to Capricorn In the case of even, signs they arc allotted to ten signs as counted from the ninth sign onwards. In odd signs the first 4 divisions are presided by Brahma, Vishnu. Hara and Ravi (gods of Hindus) and the remaining are allotted to twelve signs, counted from the sign itself. In even signs the order is reversed. (x) Shashti-anshas. A sign is sub-divided into 60 divisions each constituted by 30' (thirty minutes of arc or half a degree). 878. In case of even signs, the above are deemed benefic the rest are deemed malefic. To find whether and how far a planet is good or bad we examine how it is placed in the above 10 categories or 'Vargas'. (a) A planet in its own sub-division or in its exaltation subdivision is deemed strong. (b) A planet in its great friend's or friend's sub-division is deemed good. (c) A planet in its enemy's house, sub-division or great enemy's house/sub-division or in its depression sign/ vargas is deemed malefic. (d) A planet in sub-divisions owned by benefics is deemed good.

1. PREFACE A fter overwhelming response of Times Prasna Jyotish (Hindi) the need of English version of this book was greatly felt by astrologers across the country. The present book is the translation of Hindi version with new added live examples. The defects which persisted in Hindi version have been rectified to make it more and more useful to esteemed readers. K.P. astrology is getting momentum day by day due to its Practical utility and for making scintillating predictions. The importance of traditional astrology can neither be mitigated nor ignored because all systems of prognostication of future have got generated from it.

2. K.P. too is not exception. The book is unique blending of K.P. as well as traditional astrology. The proved principles of traditional astrology have been beautifully incorporated with K.P. to make it more meaningful and trustworthy. After making tedious research over a decade of time various confusions which persisted even in the books of KP. have been sorted out with logical explainations. In present time the utility of horary astrology as compare to natal astrology is much more and unparallel due to its practical utility. Horary astrology has given rise to mobile astrology or telephone astrology.

3. The querent need not to present himself or herself before astrologer but simply can ask any question any time from any part of world on mobile or telephone. Within 10 minutes he is given clear cut answer either in yes or no. Thus horary astrology has not only saved the time of people but also saved their energy and money. There is a some sort of confusion over selection of ruling planets. This confusion is not only present in software of astrology but also persisted in the book of KP.

4. After solving more than one thousand questions of horary astrology I have reached the conclusion that selection of ruling planets is almost incorrect and erroneous. Proper explanation have been given in the book over selection of ruling planets. The another important feature of this book is that practical case study examples have been classified into house wise. Now it is very simple and convenient for the readers to select to which query which house or cusp is to be considered. Few questions for which no particular house is judged have also been included in this book so that reader may become familiar with such type of queries.

5. I would like to bring to the knowledge of reader that any book of the world is only a source of information. The intellect and wisdom convert it into knowledge. Thus the ultimate source of knowledge is intellect and wisdom of the readers. I would also like to make it clear that the contents of whole book are the out come of research and deep concentration only on horary astrology. Each sentence and all the examples included in the book have been found to be practically correct without exceptions. The theory part of this book is absolutely based on proved cases therefore each word each sentence is very important for the readers.

6. Specific comments have also been given in few cases in which a confusion may arise in the mind of readers. I hope readers will give same warm response to the book what they gave to Hindi version. I also request to the readers of this book to bring to my knowledge any fallacy or missing part which they think ought to be included in the book. I am thankful to my all clients whose continuous interaction helped me to deal with questions of different nature and different varieties. I owe my sincere thanks to the editor and publisher of this book smt Rajeshwari Shanker for encouraging me to write the book in English and also taking all pains from cover designing to printing and ultimately bringing out this book.

7. I am also thankful to my all students who provided me opportunity to teach them and also for different questions they posed during classroom lectures due to which I could update my knowledge as well could go deep into horary astrology. I also pay my special thanks to my student Shri Anuj Jain Delhi based astrologer who is always in touch with me with different type of questions. He devoted a lot of time and energy to proof corrections and advised me to concentrate on various aspects of this books.

8. This book could never be completed without his sincere and selfless service. May god bless him and all my students. In the last but not least I pay my sincere thanks, respect and love to my wife Dr. Vatsala Prabhaker who inspite of her busiest schedule burnt mid night oil with me in the completion of this book. As I did not have time but her timely support helped me to complete this book. I also bow my head before almighty God Lord Ganesha for his grace which ignited in me a passion for astrology.

9. May Lord Ganesh grant peace and happiness to all. Goodluck April 2006 Dr. Arastu Prabhaker 14, Saraswati Nagar, PART-I (Theory) Brief History of Horary Astrology H orary Astrology (Indian) It is very difficult to answer when Horary astrology came into existence. However it could be assumed that with the dawn of human existence the astrology too got evolved with the evolution of mankind. Vedas have mentioned about astrology and the oldest Veda is Rig Veda. 10. Horary astrology used to be' called Hora Shastra as per ancient classical literatures. It means Horary astrology was studied as separate branch or quite distinct subject from general astrology. 105. Sub lord T he zodiac is divided into 27 constellations or stars. Each constellation is 13° 20' or 800 minutes in longitude. Each constellation is divided into 4 quarters or pads. Each sign or Rasi consists of 214 constellations i.e. 9 pads. Each sign or Rasi = 30° or 30x60 = 1800 min. Each quarter of constellations= 3°20 or (3 x 60) + 20 = 200 minutes Each sign consists of 9 quarter of constellation i.e. 200x9 = 1800 min. Each constellation has four quarters. Therefore 27 constellations will have 27 x 4 = 108 quarters.

106. These 108 quarters have further been divided into 249 parts. Each sub divided Part is called sub lord. For example Aries sign consists of 4 quarter of Ashwini star, 4 quarters of Bhami star and one quarter of Krittika star. Ashwani star is ruled by Ketu and have been allotted 7 years out of 120 years of Vimshottari dashapattern. Ashwani star is 13° 20 or 800 min. in longitude. Now 800 min of ashwini star are further divided in respect to 7 years of Ketu. The result obtained is called sub or sub lord of Ketu.

3. In this method a cusp that rises at any point of sign not necessarily end in that sign. Similarly, two houses may occupy a single sign. This unequal distribution of house in zodiac leads drifting of sign lords. The Sign lord may or may not have control on full house. At times he even may not have a house to rule. Therefore a reference point was needed to a cusp that commences and ends in the same sign to attribute the responsibility of a house. A sub lord commences and ends in the same sign.

4. Thus the point of rising of this cusp lord attributed with utmost power to decide the matter of the cusp for which he is a sub lord. Since this sub lord is a divisional lord of a star in that zodiac, the star lord is attributed the power to indicate the nature of the cusp for which he is a Star lord. Cusp Linking originated in K.P. Activation of sub lord or a star lord of a cusp is done by a planet which is in the stars of above Sub lord or Star lord.

5. In the event of no planet situated in their stars, the Sub and Star lord themselves entitled to decide the cusp results. The indication of sub lord is of utmost importance in deciding the matter of a significator. Indication means the positional and lordship dignities of either the sub or the star where the sub lord is posited. Sub negates a significator means, the negative results of the sub is effective.

7. If that sub is positive, the positive results will be effective. It ultimately means that the sub lord is most important in giving positive or negative results. Depending upon the beginning of cusp the house drifts. Due to this there is possibility of a sign skipping the house leaving its lord deprive of a particular house signification. Due to this phenomenon, the star level and further division of its sub level are considered as major signifying factor to a particular house under consideration. Authentication for Stellar division Fundamentals of division of house in stellar astrology, is based on the ancient works.

24. For this purpose we need to know a few fundamentals from Sage Parasara's "Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra". Here the great maharshi has presented two sets of division. One is a Static Division based on the Signs and the other is stellar division which is Dynamic division based on the Stars. The Static Divisions are represented by sign lords. This will facilitate to assess the strengths of the planet. However in order to identify divisional lords several charts are cast. The purpose of these charts though, fundamentally to assess the strength of planets, the great author also recommend to study of such divisional charts for specific areas of life.

25. However, it does not deal with the methodology of studying these charts. Subsequently scholars in this field have dealt with this subject with diverse opinion. But the common utility to assess the strength of the planet is well accepted universally in traditional astrology. This static analysis of chart with various divisional dignities will describe the quality of significations of the house and planets. 2. DYNAMIC DIVISION Having arrived at the qualitative significations of houses and planets, it is essential to time the events (fructification of signified results.) For timing the events there should be a progressive component which should not only be dynamic but also sequential with appropriate changes in life.

26. For this purpose, the stellar division is used. Every star which is sequentially distributed in each sign is taken into consideration. 27 stars were grouped in to 3 sets of 9 in a zone of 120 degrees in zodiac. Three stars from zone were assigned a planet as ruler. For example, the Star Ashwini, Makha and Moola are ruled by Ketu and Bharani, Pubba, and Uttaraashada were ruled by Venus. Similarly all the nine planets were allotted in the order of stellar sequence. Then each planet was allotted a number of years as ruling period.

27. Note: The number of years allotted to each planet as per Parasara is as follows: a. Sun-6 years, Moon-10 Years, Mars-7 Years, Rahu-18 years, Jupiter-16 years, Saturn-17 years, Mercury-17 years, Ketu-7 years and Venus-20 years. Total 120 years allotted to all the 9 planets. These periods of each planet is called as Dasha. b. Further division based on the same number of years were repeated to each planet which would give the sub division period. This is called Bhukti (some calls it Antardasha). c. To time the event still closer, divisions like Antra, Sookshma, etc., were also introduced.

28. But none of the classical texts reveal the basis of allotment of number of years allotted to the planet. But many scholars off late have presented this by several metaphysical and/or life cycle theories. Our sages had understood the creation and were experts in astronomy. They wrote astrological texts based on astronomical facts. Therefore, none of their dictums were a myth. With this firm belief, we at Hyderabad, have started research in this field and have been successful in deriving at the astronomical phenomena to support many of the astrological dictums propounded by sage Parasara and Jaimini.

29. The distribution of Zodiac signs, the Lordship allotted to them, the term Exaltation, Debilitation, Retrogression, and their impact were all based on the most advanced scientific temper. These led us to further probe into the orbital theory and derive the astronomical solution to the allotment of Dasha period to planets. Our research team will come out with their Magnum opus on this subject with astronomical details supporting the astrological theory. This note is to establish the fact that, the great astrological works of our sages were highly technical and based on the scientific facts.

30. The sages were high intellectuals. Nothing was hypothesis or myth. They presented their works for high intellectuals who mastered the technicalities of the universe and understood creation. To time an event, the stellar Dynamic divisions were adopted. Further, to arrive at closer timing of an event fine tuning of planetary transits were introduced. There were great astrologers who had adopted this system perfectly to give detailed predictions of charts. However down the line somewhere the thread was de-linked. Many corrupted versions crept in and the dictums were way led to confusion confounded.

CONCEPT OF HOUSE SYSTEM Though there was a system of unequal house and Bhavaarambha, Bhava-Madhya and Bhava-Sandhi, this concept was further fine tuned with western concept of division of houses, by Prof.

32. KSK. Here the houses were computed by Placidus method. Due to different time span of each sign, a house computed by this system need not necessarily be confined to a sign. It may extend to other sign. Even two houses may fall in one sign leading to its opposite sign to contain two more houses. This will deprive Lordship to certain planets of their house lordship. The lordships drifting and extending to other signs and some signs loosing ruler ship lead to uncertainty of ruler ship of houses by sign lords.
